messages:
Zoe: quick design callout 3: our prompt-sets filter label 'All' is confusing in the scorecard. people ask: does it mean 'match all selected tags' or 'show all results'? thinking we should change labels and add microcopy.
Ben: agree. real confusion in support tickets. suggestion: change 'All' -> 'No filters' when nothing selected, and when tags selected show 'Match any' or 'Match all' depending on mode.
Aria: accessibility note: the toggle that switches between 'Match any' and 'Match all' needs clear aria-label and state. screenreader should announce the current logic: "Tag matching: any".
Tom: what about default behavior? we default to OR (match any). we can add a tiny hint under filters: "Tags: match any by default". keeps simple.
a11y-bot: suggestion: use a toggle button with role="switch" and aria-checked, and provide aria-describedby linking to the hint text.
Zoe: also debating density on scorecard rows. compact mode hides helper microcopy; could cause more confusion about filter semantics. maybe keep hint visible in compact but smaller font.
Ben: metric: when hint removed, support tickets about "missing results" increase by ~12% in A/B test. keep hint but abbreviated: "Tags = any; filters combined = AND".
Aria: keyboard nav: ensure the filter helper is focusable so keyboard users can learn the rule. and SR should read the rule when filter area receives focus.
Tom: implementation: change label text, add a small info icon with accessible tooltip, and add a short in-line helper. I'll scope this as a small UI copy + a11y change.
Zoe: action items: Tom to implement copy + tooltip (1d), Aria to draft a11y acceptance steps, Ben to check metrics post-deploy. quick ship if no objections.
Ben: no objections. rolling to staging. :shipit:
